CVE-2010-4756.reason: Upstream disputes or treats this as a security limitation; no upstream fix is available. The maintained media-job interface does not accept arbitrary POSIX regex/glob patterns, ELF execution, SQL or database files. This is a scoped exposure assessment, not a claim of a repaired library. Operator arbitrary-code execution and alternate callers are excluded.

CVE-2018-20796.reason: Upstream leaves crafted POSIX regular-expression recursion unfixed/disputed. The immutable image removes grep/egrep/fgrep, and the media interface exposes no caller POSIX regex. Python text matching uses its separate engine; decoder/filter arguments are fixed. This removes a specific entry path, not glibc regex code.
